name: dutch
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-30. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.543B parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-08. 'Simple fine-tuning' per the card - Whisper's own tokenizer, ASR objective only.
